positive_controls.witness: The frozen use-case suite starts the base and fully reordered/deduplicated request concurrently and requires one run and one queue commit.
The real-store suite reads every confirmed publication/transition immediately and verifies the final terminal after reopen.
Pagination is repeated with a changed limit and the same cursor continues after reopen with the same secret.
Integrated queue/L4 tests distinguish queued removal, CANCELLING and worker-confirmed CANCELLED, with duplicate cancel stability.
Predecessor hashes and literal response goldens pass, while the real RecommendationService produces equal synchronous and observed results through shared provider ports.

survivor_groups.reason: Finite ID samples do not reject every derivation from user-controlled fields; retry after INTERRUPTED remains unexercised; nested validation is not exhaustive; quota-full Start is not observed with all durable and executor effects counted.

No candidate-facing witness covers terminal-only republish, publication CAS losers, every stage/progress mismatch, result publication after a lost terminal race, full real-store recovery, acceptance ordering, shutdown/reopen, actual PENDING visibility, or authoritative orphan/index combinations.

Required-artifact failures, constant-time MAC behavior and all physical-kind checks remain partial; R4 crash cases execute a synthetic local protocol whose reference confirmation is hard-coded false, not the real store or a declared reference/mutant port.

Privacy traversal, persisted raw executor errors, closed JSON validation, full architectural constraints, filesystem kinds/permissions and zero-materialization lookup semantics remain incompletely witnessed by candidate-facing suites.

unknown_policy_audit.negative_unknown_treatment: Any missing, synthetic or ambiguous negative witness is SURVIVED.

causal_gate_audit.finding: R4 replaced ID dispatch with category dispatch and checks vocabulary from mutation/stimulus/witness, but its programs manufacture reference and mutant observations inside the gate. The frozen manifest-bound suites and declared mutant implementations are not invoked by the R4 driver.
examples: P01-P04 only test whether fixed phrases occur in the attack text; they do not execute canonicalization, lifecycle, cursor or cancellation behavior.
Identity hashes local sample strings; idempotency conflict, canonical hash, queue/quota, status and terminal cases assign toy reference/mutant values rather than run an implementation under attack.
Filesystem cases write gate-owned files and then label pre/post observations as reference/mutant; this is not differential execution of two store implementations.
physicalCrashProgram performs OpenFile, Write, Sync, Rename and directory Sync in TempDir, but hard-codes reference confirmed=false and observes the same synthetic protocol as the mutant.
Layering parses invented source strings, retrocompatibility hard-codes certified true/false after hash checks, and shared orchestration calls a local closure instead of the candidate-facing seams.
causal_gate_audit.conclusion: The passing R4 3x3 run proves determinism of gate-owned toy models and keyword bindings, not independent discrimination of M01-M60.
